title: Dynex Partners with InCor to Transform Healthcare AI with Quantum-as-a-Service Technology
description: Dynex, a leader in Quantum-as-a-Service (QaaS) technology, has partnered with the Heart Institute (InCor) at the University of São Paulo Medical School to leverage its neuromorphic quantum computing platform for training advanced AI models in healthcare. The collaboration aims to optimize workflows, enhance clinical decision-making, and improve patient outcomes while reducing energy consumption and costs.
